# Embedded notices

The original header and root LICENSE notices are retained. This distribution
selects the zlib alternative for the cute code; the original public-domain
alternative remains available as written upstream.

`cute_net.h` embeds libhydrogen. `LIBHYDROGEN_LICENSE` is the ISC text obtained
from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jedisct1/libhydrogen/master/LICENSE`
on 2026-11-26. The embedded Curve25519 code separately identifies Michael
Hamburg's STROBE reference implementation and Copyright (c) 2015–2016
Cryptography Research, Inc., MIT. `STROBE_LICENSE` reproduces the standard MIT
grant with that attribution; the original attribution remains in the header.

Source snapshot identity for cute itself is in
`../../extensions/bundles_extra/SOURCE_ENTRIES.json`. License additions do not
claim that the embedded libhydrogen algorithm version equals current upstream.
